title: Quant fidelity sentinel and auto-rollback playbook
creator: Aisha Morgan
description:
Problem: We frequently roll out quantized model variants (int8/int4, AWQ/GPTQ) and configuration changes that materially affect latency and cost but occasionally produce subtle regressions in generation quality for specific cohorts. Current deploys rely on global eval snapshots and manual rollback, which is slow and noisy.

Goal: Implement a 'sentinel' driven evaluation and automatic rollback playbook that: (1) runs a lightweight, cohort-aware eval suite at deploy time for each quant/profile change; (2) wires continuous post-deploy monitoring to detect drift/regressions against production sample cohorts; (3) defines deterministic rollback gates and a remediation path (canary hold, auto-rollback, or gradual unwind).

Scope: This ticket covers the automation framework and detection logic; it will not onboard every model family immediately but will provide templates for AWQ/GPTQ int8/int4 profiles and integration points for the Console and alerting rules.
acceptance_criteria: Deploy-time sentinel runs automatically for any quant-profile change and completes within 10 minutes for standard models (7B/13B).
Cohort-level quality deltas (BLEU/ROUGE/LM-agnostic metrics + sampling-based human proxies) surface in a standardized report and are persisted to the eval dashboard.
Rollback policy executes automatically when a profile exceeds configured deltas for >N requests or fails canary checks (configurable per-project).
Playbook documentation updated with runbook steps, escalation paths, and sample alert messages.
Unit/e2e tests covering sentinel runner, gating logic, and alert generation are merged and passing.
success_metrics: Reduction in time-to-detect quant regressions from deploy -> alert from ~6h to <15m
Decrease in manual rollback incidents by 60% for quant-profile rollouts
False-positive rollback triggers under 2% across the next two months of canary runs
test_plan: Create synthetic cohorts: short-answer QA, code-completion snippets, instruction-following prompts. Run baseline (float32) vs AWQ-int8 / GPTQ-int4 variants and store metrics.
Smoke test runner: simulate deploy hook that kicks sentinel, verify artifacts written to s3 and Eval dashboard link created.
Canary flow: deploy to 5% traffic, run online sample-evaluator for 30 minutes, ensure gating rules evaluate and either promote or trigger rollback mock.
Chaos test: introduce controlled degradation (e.g., forced token deletion noise) to ensure automatic rollback triggers and alerting path works end-to-end.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal): wire sentinel for int8/AWQ profiles on internal canary models. 2-week observation window.
Phase 2 (customer pilot): enable automation for select Dedicated customers with explicit opt-in and stronger canary constraints.
Phase 3 (GA): expose profile gating controls in Console; default to conservative thresholds with ability to tune per-project.
monitoring_queries: SQL (eval delta): SELECT cohort, metric, baseline, variant, baseline - variant AS delta FROM eval_results WHERE run_id = '{{run}}' ORDER BY ABS(delta) DESC LIMIT 50;
Online sampling rule (pseudocode): count(regressed_samples WHERE metric_delta > threshold) OVER 1h > 10 -> emit alert 'quant-fidelity-regression'
